description: This file provides coupon-related services including fetching, validating, and calculating discounts for coupons in a shopping application. It also manages coupon code persistence in local storage.

methods.name: normalizeCoupons
methods.description: Normalizes and checks the shape of coupons coming from backend data.

methods.name: fetchCoupons
methods.description: Fetches coupons from backend API or falls back to mock coupons.

methods.name: findCouponByCode
methods.description: Finds a coupon by code, case-insensitive.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if a coupon is expired based on its expiry date.

methods.name: validateCoupon
methods.description: Validates if a coupon is valid, not expired, and meets minimum subtotal.

methods.name: computeDiscount
methods.description: Calculates discount amount and total after discount based on coupon type.

methods.name: getAppliedCode
methods.description: Retrieves the persisted coupon code from local storage.

methods.name: setAppliedCode
methods.description: Persists or removes the coupon code in local storage.
